caption_L1: Here a is a area plot named Goat production in Malaysia from 2005 to 2018 (in 1,000 heads). The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis plots Production in thousand heads.
caption_L2L3: The goat production in Malaysia from 2005 to 2009 jumped from less than 300 thousand to over 500 thousand and it was the biggest jump in the timeline between 2005-2018. Since 2009 it started to drop slightly, and it was at its lowest at 2016, with about 410 thousand. Then it started to grow slightly again.
